Zara (Marketing): Quick heads up  a niche analyst blog asked to publish a short excerpt of our benchmark at 09:00 PT, citing a small audience boost. They want the chart embed. Thoughts?
Noah (PR): Who's the blog? Is it on our embargo list?
Zara (Marketing): 'EdgeMetrics' - not on our embargo list. They emailed asking for an early embed of one chart, not the full post.
Ivy (Legal): No contractual obligation. Decision is comms.
Noah (PR): Agree we shouldn't give early excerpts that leak charts. Could offer a cropped preview image under embargo but not an embed that could be redistributed.
Rae (Social): If they embed, social might pick it up and syndicate before our window. That's risky.
ops-bot: preview.link.create  post_id=bench-2026-21; preview_allowed=false at 1945551350
Zara (Marketing): Proposed reply: "We can offer an embargoed screenshot for review at 09:00 PT but cannot authorize publication of that material before our official publish at 15:00 PT."
Noah (PR): Add: "By accepting the screenshot you agree to the embargo; unauthorized publication prior to 15:00 PT is a breach."
Ivy (Legal): Good. Also log the request in the embargo tracker.
Zara (Marketing): Reply sent. Copy pasted: ---
Hi  we can provide an embargoed screenshot at 09:00 PT for review only. Live publication remains 15:00 PT; publication before that without consent is a breach. Please confirm you will hold.
Best, Zara
---
Noah (PR): Nice. If they push back, we decline. If they agree, grant read-only preview and monitor.
ops-bot: embargo.tracker.add  requester=EdgeMetrics; post_id=bench-2026-21; preview_time=09:00 PT at 1945551500
Zara (Marketing): EdgeMetrics confirmed they'll hold. Leaving thread open in case they slip.
Sam (CEO): Thanks team. Good call on keeping control of the assets.
Rae (Social): Standing by to adjust social timing if anything changes.
